purpose: Determine whether Binance spot and futures availability is execution-context dependent and whether current-run routing reliably prevents stale fallback data from being treated as live.
hypothesis: Binance availability varies by execution context or session; therefore every run must test current access and route to an independent current baseline while preserving stale Binance observations only as timestamped reference evidence.
confirmation_rule: At least two additional pass/fail availability transitions occur across bounded runs or access outcomes correlate with execution context while stale-fallback guards continue to prevent false-live classification.
falsification_rule: The restriction is a one-off event and at least five subsequent comparable runs show stable availability without context-dependent transitions.
use_restriction: SOURCE_QA_ONLY; DOES_NOT_CHANGE MARKET STATE, ROTATION, ENTRY OR PORTFOLIO ACTION
